newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia avg lending rate drops to 11.2 vs 12.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia avg lending rate drops to 11.2 vs 12.7 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate fell to 11.2 percent on Monday from 12.7 percent, weighed down by the volume of cheaper call money loans.
Total trade was put at 43.3 million kuna and fresh loans accounted for 22 million kuna.
The weighted call money rate ended at 9.9 percent as some lenders granted loans at a lower than regular 10-percent price.
Term rates ranged between 11 and 13 percent for one-week deals and 18 percent, charged to savings banks for renewed two-month money.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Tuesday firmer at 6.1561 against the dollar and 3.5648 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
